text:
emma_ml: FYI I'm starting the sq3b-int3 bring-up tomorrow. Before we run quant-smoke we need a tighter promptset curation pass.
raj: what are the top nuisance signals from the earlier warmups?
emma_ml: short list: list-form tokenization drift, paraphrase clusters that are semantically same but differ by entity placeholders, and system/instruction duplications inflating eval counts. Also some markdown->plaintext truncation issues.
lucas: propose we run a 3-phase flow: exact dedupe -> fuzzy pairs -> label borderline -> golden bake. keep an explicit longctx fraction.
emma_ml: plan sketch: 
  1) exact hash dedupe (drop exact duplicates)
  2) fuzzy dedupe with sim threshold 0.78, mark 0.65-0.78 as borderline
  3) push borderline to `sq3b-int3-label` with entropy tag and domain tag (code, convo, lists)
  4) construct golden set: 800 examples, 40% longctx (>2k tokens), 20% code, 10% adversarial edgecases
  5) run `sq3b_quant_smoke.yaml` + `bench_compare_ref.yaml`
maya: sounds good. can you share the dedupe command? would rather we run locally on a node with 256GB RAM.
emma_ml: yep: 
```bash
python infra/dedupe_tool.py \
  --src s3://redwood/promptbank/sq3b-raw.jsonl \
  --mode fuzzy \
  --sim-threshold 0.78 \
  --borderline 0.65,0.78 \
  --keep-long-frac 0.4 \
  --out s3://redwood/promptbank/sq3b-curated.jsonl
```
raj: good. for borderline labeling, let's prioritize items where baseline entropy > 1.2 AND token-diff > 5. that's been a strong signal for flips.
lucas: also flag examples with list-bullets and inline codeblocks, those consistently cause tokenization zingers.
ops-bot: NOTE: Provisioning labeling queue `sq3b-int3-label`. ETA 15m. Estimated capacity 1,200/hr for first 8h.
labeler-bot: Assigned 10 senior annotators and 6 reviewers to `sq3b-int3-label`. Labeling rubric url: https://labeler.redwood.ai/rubrics/sq3b-int3.
maya: what's the QA pass rate threshold for golden inclusion?
emma_ml: require >= 90% reviewer agreement and no more than 5% corrections on answer intent. For code prompts require runnable check for at least one reference language.
raj: after we have curated set, can we run both `bench_compare_ref.yaml` and a differential hallucination harness (longctx hallucination 5k) to compare int3 vs int8 baseline?
emma_ml: yes, the plan is to run int3 (quant) vs host-int8 baseline and log token-level latency, regression F1 on gold, and hallucination delta. If int3 shows >7% drop on any critical slice we'll consider fallback to int8 for that shard.
lucas: add a slice for multi-turn roleplay prompts and for list-summarization; those are subtle.
ops-bot: Adversarial slice: pulling 250 prompts from `edgecase-bank/v2` and will append to golden with prefix `ADV-`.
labeler-bot: First batch of 500 borderline pairs pushed to queue. Batches contain entropy metadata and suggested reviewer priority.
maya: I'll start a small canary run on Dedicated (2 GPUs) as soon as the first 1k curated items are in S3. Keep logs here: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/sq3b-canary/logs
emma_ml: timeline: dedupe & push -> 24h, labeling QA -> 48h, golden bake & evals -> next 12h.
raj: one more ask: capture tokenizer diffs in the eval artifacts (token ids and lengths). that's how we tracked the markdown truncation regressions last quarter.
emma_ml: good call. adding `token-diff` artifact in the eval config.
lucas: small nudge: ensure golden retains at least 15% non-English prompts for regression coverage.
emma_ml: will keep 15% non-en and keep language metadata.
maya: ping me when 500 labeled so I can start canary.
labeler-bot: 500 labeled milestone reached. Report: 94% inter-reviewer agreement, 3.6% intent-corrections. Link: https://labeler.redwood.ai/reports/sq3b-500
emma_ml: awesome. kicking off canary now. Will update when quant-smoke + bench compare complete.
raj: thanks all. please paste the final golden manifest here when done. :pray:
